title: Acting on Doubt (AoD): priced escalation and delay-corrected learning for budget-constrained IoT intrusion response — code, simulator and results
description: Code, trace-driven simulator, raw result records and figures accompanying the manuscript 'Acting on Doubt: Priced Escalation and Delay-Corrected Learning for Budget-Constrained IoT Intrusion Response' (the manuscript itself is not included). Detection and response are posed as one budget-constrained POMDP in which a device may wait, contain itself, or pay to escalate evidence to a gateway detector, and learning uses only delayed, censored breach confirmations (IPCW-corrected). The study is simulation-only: detector scores come from real flows of CICIoT2023, Edge-IIoTset and NF-ToN-IoT-v3; the source datasets are not redistributed (see data/README.md), but the cached detector score pools allow every experiment to be rerun.
